inputs.text: [excited] 15 feet long — as long as a big SUV! [quickly] About 5 feet tall — as tall as a car — you'd have to look up! And about 2,600 pounds — [amazed] as heavy as a cow and a horse put together!
[curious] And his frill, was it big?
[playful] Pretty short, for a horned dinosaur. [proud] But lined all around with spikes, like a crown.
